fact: In April 2024 the Municipal Council of Manzini announced 2024/2025 rates bills sent by post, email and bulk SMS, with payment by USSD *440# (which also shows rates balances), EFT, debit order, mobile money and card, and asked ratepayers to update contact and ownership details held by the council, so Manzini keeps its own ratepayer records with balances per plot account.
title: Rates Bills for 2024/2025 Financial Year Now Available
